comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs. trigger_segment must match a route segment name exactly. min_point_index (default 0) lets a mid-segment community fire only after the car passes that route-point index. Set needs_owner_review:true for placements the owner should validate with lived knowledge.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow sand spit from Norman Manley Airport to Kingston Harbour; coconut trees line both shoulders

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway to Kingston at the landward end of the Palisadoes

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: East Kingston; site of the 1694 Rockfort fort and the Rockfort Mineral Bath

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston residential community at the foot of the Blue Mountains

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern commercial and hotel district

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major commercial hub of St. Andrew; the 1813 clock tower marks the crossroads

communities.name: Hagley Park
communities.note: West Kingston neighbourhood; gateway onto Spanish Town Road

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former colonial capital; the 1762 Parade Square is a UNESCO World Heritage contender

communities.name: Bog Walk Gorge
communities.note: Dramatic limestone gorge carved by the Rio Cobre; Flat Bridge marks the heart

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town of St. Catherine; immortalised in the folk song Linstead Market

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small St. Catherine town near the Bog Walk junction; alumina works lie nearby

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann hill town sitting in a natural depression — the lake dried long ago

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 3 km of road through a ravine thick with wild ferns — a beloved Jamaican landmark

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann tourist town; Dunn's River Falls and the journey's end await
